fullPassage: It was lunchtime, and a group of us were picnicking with our kids. Three-year-old Jack was having a tantrum in front of his father. His dad picked him up, held his arms pressed against his body so he couldn't wiggle around, put his face close to the toddler's, and said, "Now tell me what you want. Don't whine or hit, just tell me, and then I can help you." Jack was pouty for another moment; then he said, "I'm very hungry, Daddy, and I don't want any of those things for lunch." questions.passage: It was lunchtime, and a group of us were __________ (picnic) with our kids. Three-year-old Jack was having a tantrum in front of his father.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'a group of us were ___ with our kids'에서 were 뒤에는 동사의 -ing형이 와서 과거진행형(were + -ing)을 만들어요. 그래서 picnic → picnicking(소풍을 하고 있었다)이 돼요. picnic은 -c로 끝나므로 k를 붙여 picnicking으로 철자해요.
det.tip: were + V-ing(과거진행형). picnic → picnicking (k 추가).

questions.passage: Marsha later asked Jack's dad if he knew what the youngster had __________ (want).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'what the youngster had ___'에서 had 뒤에는 과거분사가 와서 과거완료(had + p.p.)를 만들어요. want의 과거분사는 규칙형이라 wanted예요. '그 아이가 무엇을 원했었는지'라는 뜻이 돼요.
det.tip: had + 과거분사(과거완료). want → wanted.

questions.passage: It was lunchtime, and a group of us were picnicking with our kids. Three-year-old Jack was having a tantrum in front of his father. His dad picked him up, held his arms pressed against his body so he couldn't wiggle around, put his face close to the __________'s, and said, "Now tell me what you want. Don't whine or hit, just tell me, and then I can help you." Jack was pouty for another moment; then he said, "I'm very hungry, Daddy, and I don't want any of those things for lunch." Having witnessed this episode, Marsha later asked Jack's dad if he knew what the youngster had wanted. "Of course," he said. "But I wanted him to tell me. I say all the time to him, 'Use your words.' So does my wife, but she means, 'Don't whine.' I mean, 'Explain what you want.'"

det.analysis:
아빠가 얼굴을 가까이 댄 대상은 세 살 Jack이므로 빈칸은 toddler(걸음마 아기)예요.

det.korean: 빈칸 = Explain what you want(원하는 것을 설명하라)
det.analysis:
아빠는 'Use your words'가 자기에게는 '원하는 것을 설명하라'는 뜻이라고 밝혀요. 아이에게 말로 표현하게 하는 흐름이므로 빈칸은 Explain what you want예요.

① Keep it a secret(비밀로 하라): 말하게 하려는 의도와 반대예요

② Stop talking now(이제 말 그만해라): 말하라는 흐름과 반대예요

③ Finish your lunch(점심을 다 먹어라): 말로 표현하는 주제와 무관해요

④ Explain what you want(원하는 것을 설명하라): 'Use your words'의 아빠식 의미로 적절 ← 정답
det.tip: I mean, '___' → 원하는 것을 설명하라(Explain what you want)
